# Global nutrition and supplement storefront teardown

Purpose: borrow the conversion logic (never the look) of the highest-converting global sports-nutrition and supplement storefronts, for OptimalX on Salla.
Research date: 2026-09-17. All page observations below were made on that date unless noted. Every fact carries its source URL. Where a page could not be fetched, the section says so rather than guessing.

Method: for each retailer, the home page, one category page and one product detail page (PDP) were fetched with Firecrawl (rendered markdown) or WebFetch. Observations are limited to what the fetched markup exposed; client-side widgets that did not render (some review carousels, some sticky bars) are marked "not observable in fetch".
